reference_source: The game's art bible folder. The repo override work/look/config.json sets it.
critic_model_reason: Not set. Use a cheaper vision model; write the reason here.

_sources.picked_key: The game's art bible key for the view
_sources.reference_dir: The key images, copied to the game repo refs/
_sources.criteria_min: A public dev report used 12 criteria (RUSuper)
_sources.max_tries: Fix loops repeat a failed idea (gotchas.md 16)
_sources.camera_mode: A visual claim counts only from the player camera; POC follow camera at 2.6 m
_sources.max_godot_instances: USER: machine cap on game processes; set it for your RAM
_sources.godot_timeout_s: PROPOSED: a headless Godot can hang on a dialog
_sources.verdict: USER: no absolute ship score. The critic gives an A/B call (closer to the key) and a gap list; the user is the ship gate.

key_source: The game's art bible, foundation/07-art-bible.md, section 'Key image'. A game can have 1 key per view. The repo override work/look/config.json names the key file per view.
camera_mode_note: The main view of the game. The repo override sets it (for example: follow at 2.6 m in a third-person game; chase in Crush Depth).
